form.label: Active Directory Security & Audit Dashboard
form.description: Active Directory security toolkit: event-driven AD monitoring (changes, groups, users, password anomalies, lockouts), real-time LDAP queries (ldap-* dashboards, needs SA-ldapsearch), and AD attribute security checks. This page verifies required add-ons, lookups, indexes, DCs, and audit event codes.

input.label: 🔍 Global Search Filter
input.placeholder: Filter all panels (e.g., username, group name)

div.style: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd 0%, #bbdefb 100%); padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; color: #0d47a1; margin-bottom: 0;
div.h1: Active Directory Security & Audit — Health Check
div.p: Environment readiness and requirements verification for AD security monitoring. Confirms that the required add-ons, lookups, data sources, Domain Controllers, and audit event codes are all in place.

search.query: `DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") | head 1 | stats count as total | eval status = if(total>0, "✅ Data Present", "❌ No Data Found") | table status

html.div: If no data is found, set the correct Domain Controller index in App Setup page.

div.style: background: #e8eaf6; padding: 15px 20px; border-radius: 6px; color: #1a237e; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;

search.query: | makeresults count=1 | eval app=split("Splunk_TA_windows,SA-ldapsearch", ",") | mvexpand app | join type=left app [| rest /services/apps/local | rename title as app | where app IN ("Splunk_TA_windows","SA-ldapsearch") | fields app label version | rename label as Name, version as Version | eval Installed="✅ Installed"] | eval Installed=coalesce(Installed, "❌ Not Installed") | eval Name=coalesce(Name, "—") | eval Version=coalesce(Version, "—") | eval Requirement=case( app="Splunk_TA_windows", "Hard requirement — field extraction for Windows Security events", app="SA-ldapsearch", "Optional — required for dashboards prefixed ldap-*", true(), "—") | rename app as App | table App Name Requirement Installed Version | sort App

html.div: Install / update add-ons via Apps → Manage Apps. A restart may be required.

div.style: background: #e0f2f1; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 4px solid #00695C; margin-bottom: 8px;
div.p: Verifies which Domain Controllers are actively sending logs and whether required audit event codes are being collected. Missing event codes usually indicate an audit policy that must be enabled via Group Policy on the DC.

search.query: `DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") | stats count by host | table host count | sort - count

panel.title: Active Event Codes per Audit Class

search.query: `DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") | lookup cs_eventcode_class.csv EventCode OUTPUT class | stats count values(EventCode) as seen_codes by class | append [ | inputlookup cs_eventcode_class.csv | stats values(EventCode) as all_codes by class ] | stats sum(count) as count values(seen_codes) as seen_codes values(all_codes) as all_codes by class | fillnull value=0 count | eval Status = if(count>0, "✅ ACTIVE", "❌ MISSING") | eval EventCodes = if(count>0, mvjoin(seen_codes, ", "), mvjoin(all_codes, ", ")) | table class Status EventCodes count | sort class
| ldapsearch domain="default" search="(&(samAccountName=Administrator))" attrs="uSNChanged,lastLogonTimestamp,sAMAccountName" | table sAMAccountName lastLogonTimestamp uSNChanged

html.div: If this panel is empty, SA-ldapsearch is not configured correctly. LDAP command errors appear under Job → Inspect → Messages after the search runs. Configure the connection under Apps → SA-ldapsearch → Configuration (set a default domain).
